query:
UPDATE firm_fee_structures ffs
JOIN law_firms lf ON lf.id = ffs.firmId
SET 
  ffs.antiMoneyLaunderingFee = 49.00,
  ffs.leaseholdSupplement = 149.00,
  ffs.fileOpeningFee = 175.00
WHERE lf.name LIKE '%TQ%'
  AND ffs.transactionType = 'sale';
